messages.text: BL-1719 🎵 in progress — Phantom 'You have new handoff mail' wakes: handoff-lib/wake-session remaps a wake whose recipient has no tmux session to the mono-router resident (the first non-coordinator roles.tsv row) in EVERY pack, so after the operator dropped the coder@2 seat on 2026-09-24 (fe664164b0) each wake for coder@2 was typed into the specifier's pane (4 empty wakes, 09:49:41-11:26:53Z) while coder@2's own parcels woke nowhere; inject-traffic.log carries 30 such cross-pane wakes since 2026-09-13; outside a rotation-router pack a wake for a missing session is skipped and logged, on both delivery paths
